name: Marine v2.0
description: The Marine v2.0 catalogue includes 13,223 species level clusters of which 12,133 are bacterial, 1,087 are archaeal, and three are taxonomically unclassified.
protein_catalogue_description:
Protein genome sequences from genomes in the marine catalogue v2.0 are available on [the FTP site](http://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/metagenomics/mgnify_genomes/marine/v2.0/protein_catalogue).

The sequences are available clustered at 100%, 95%, 90% and 50% amino acid identity.
